title: C_GetAttributeValue: RSA key attribute export
description: C_GetAttributeValue returns CKR_ATTRIBUTE_TYPE_INVALID for CKA_MODULUS and CKA_PUBLIC_EXPONENT on RSA keys (should return key data), and for CKA_PRIME_1/PRIME_2/PRIVATE_EXPONENT on RSA private keys (should return CKR_ATTRIBUTE_SENSITIVE). Fixes ReadWriteSessionTest.ExtractKeys.
